01

Schema mixes the two offices

The homepage reuses one Dentist ID for both offices, 24 treatment pages mix providers, and article titles and authors contain IDs or placeholders.

  • Give each office its own ID and correct provider; change Livermore’s Monday–Thursday schema opening from 07:30 to 08:00.
  • Use real service names and article titles, confirm author names, and fix the malformed social URL; keep accurate Dentist schema.
02

The insurance link opens a missing page

Two links in the affordable implants guide lead to a misspelled insurance URL that returns 404, while the correct guide is already live.

  • Update both links on the source page to the live insurance guide.
  • Add the exact 301 below so old bookmarks also reach that guide.

03

Antioch links send patients to Livermore

Seven Antioch treatment pages contain 16 body links to Livermore treatment pages, despite matching Antioch pages already being available.

  • Replace those links with the matching Antioch treatment URLs; the full source-and-anchor list is in the action plan.
  • Keep Livermore pages and navigation intact; these are direct link edits, not redirects.
04

Loading is slow and the desktop menu shifts

Mobile lab runs scored 60–62 with 6.05–10.66-second hero LCP, while desktop layout shift of 0.366 was traced to the header menu.

  • Keep the desktop header’s size stable from first paint; inspect its menu setup and font sizing.
  • Check hero priority and blocking jQuery/Oxygen CSS; preserve forms, tracking and number swapping, then retest.
05

Staff photos download larger files than needed

The desktop homepage loads 11 full-size staff portraits, with Google estimating about 2.4 MB of image-delivery savings below the first screen.

  • Serve sized photo variants for the staff slider; start with dr.-sidhu.webp (458 KB), ghazal.webp (316 KB) and elana-1.webp (316 KB).
  • Lazy-load inactive slides where safe and preserve facial detail; this reduces downloads, not a guaranteed LCP improvement.
06

Post-op instructions have two near-identical pages

Two indexable, self-canonical post-op pages repeat almost the same instructions.

  • Review both URLs and choose one patient-help page to keep; /post-op-instructions/ is a current working URL.
  • Once approved, redirect the other copy and update every referring link; do not delete educational content.
07

Search Console still lists a missing sitemap

The old category-sitemap1.xml submission returns 404 and has a Search Console error, while the current sitemap index is healthy.

  • Confirm categories are intentionally excluded, then remove only this obsolete submission from Search Console.
  • Leave the current sitemaps.xml index and its 120 working page URLs unchanged.

Fix order

Correct office data and links first, then improve loading and decide which duplicate instructions page to keep.

  • First: schema, broken insurance link and Antioch-to-Antioch treatment links.
  • Next: header stability, mobile loading, staff photo delivery, duplicate-page decision and old sitemap cleanup.

Read-only audit. Laboratory tests are not real-user measurements; Google key events are not qualified leads. Weekend hours need confirmation and are not an automatic change. Wider evidence and decisions are in the full Markdown audit.
